messages:
Alex G.: quick heads-up — Seabreeze demo went well but they dropped a handful of requests and pain points. sharing notes below.
Maria C.: thanks alex. can you paste the raw asks here? i'll start a capture doc. :clipboard:
Alex G.: pasted from the call: 
```
1) per-route cost breakdown for multi-tenant apps (they want attribution by feature)
2) UI toggle to pause batching for low-latency endpoints
3) onboard checklist with sample prompts and evals
4) exportable eval results (csv/json) for their audit team
5) better error messages when kv-cache miss + fallthrough
```
Jamie P.: good list. priority from their PM: (1)=high, (2)=medium-high, (3)=medium, (4)=high, (5)=low. they said (1) & (4) affect renewal conversation.
Lina (CS Ops): tagging renewal risk — @Maria C. can we get cost/usage history for Seabreeze last 90d? they pulled a few spikes during POC.
Maria C.: on it, pulling now. will upload to shared drive and link. ETA 2h.
Ryan E.: from eng perspective: (2) is nontrivial — need changes in runtime flags + console toggle. (5) sounds like small UX copy + a 400 vs 5xx mapping.
Alex G.: customer asked for a temporary workaround for (2) — can we offer a per-route header to force sync mode?
Ryan E.: possible — we have `x-redwood-sync` in staging. i'll test tomorrow and post snippet.
Jamie P.: thinking about prioritization: Because (1) and (4) impact renewal, suggest shipping a scoped MVP for both:
- (1) MVP = per-route daily cost export + sample mapping doc
- (4) MVP = CSV export of eval rows (no UI)
If CS can accept docs + exports, that'll buy time to build full product.
Maria C.: agreed. i'll propose that in the renewal call. Lina — can you draft a bulleted ask for the renewal playbook we can send to their execs?
Lina (CS Ops): yep. draft ready in 30m. will include acceptance criteria: CSV schema, fields, delivery cadence. :white_check_mark:
SeabreezeBot: incident: none. reminder: follow-up task assigned to Maria C. due 1715580000.
Alex G.: next steps: Ryan to validate header workaround (ETA EOD PT), Maria to upload usage and draft exec note (2h), Lina to draft playbook snippet (30m), Jamie to prepare scoped MVP tickets and estimates (tomorrow AM).
Jamie P.: I'll create the Jira epic and link here when done. aim for minimal scope that reduces renewal risk.
Maria C.: uploaded usage.csv to drive: https://drive.internal/seabreeze/onboard/usage.csv — added brief notes on spike windows.
Ryan E.: header test good on staging, sample curl: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -H "x-redwood-sync: 1" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"input":"..."}'
```
works and bypasses batching for that route. will open PR for docs.
Alex G.: awesome. i'll update the customer thread with the MVP plan + temp workaround and set renewal sync for next Tue. :pray:
Maria C.: thanks everyone. looping in execs after i get Lina's bullet list.
Jamie P.: epic created: RW-4872 (seabreeze-feedback-mvp). adding estimates and marking (1)+(4) as P0 for renewal. link: https://jira.internal/browse/RW-4872
Lina (CS Ops): draft sent in thread DM to Maria.
Alex G.: closing this capture thread — will paste customer-facing note once i send it. :rocket:
